name: Golf (Four Card)
description: Four-card Golf: 2+ players, 52 cards. Each has 4 cards in a square, two visible once. Draw or take discard to replace; knock to end hand. Lowest score wins. Also Turtle, Polish Poker Four Card.

overview.description: Four-card Golf: 2+ players, 52 cards. Each has 4 cards in a square, two visible once. Draw or take discard to replace; knock to end hand. Lowest score wins. Also Turtle, Polish Poker Four Card.

history.origins: Golf is widespread in North America, Britain, and other English-speaking countries but seldom appears in card game books. The object is to score as little as possible, as in the sport of golf; end-of-hand scores are often likened to strokes per hole. The game is commonly played over 9 or 18 deals (holes). The four-card form is also known as Turtle and as Polish Poker (Polish Polka).

setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack. With eight or more players, two packs may be shuffled together.
setup.dealing: 4 cards each, 2x2; look at 2 once. Stock and discard.

rules.objective: Lowest point total in 4-card layout. Knock ends hand.
rules.gameplay: Draw or take discard; replace one card or knock. Cannot look at face-down before choosing.

strategy.basic: Remember two cards; replace high; kings valuable.

variations.name: Pairs in row or column score zero
variations.description: Pair of equal cards in the same row or column scores zero for that pair; diagonally opposite equal cards do not cancel.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Scoring variant only; no engine constant overrides.

variations.name: Knocker penalty 10 points
variations.description: If the player who knocks does not have the lowest score, they add a penalty of 10 points to their score for that hand.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Scoring variant only; no engine constant overrides.

scoring.description: Number=face value; J/Q=10; K=0. Pairs in column often 0.
scoring.winCondition: Lowest point total in 4-card layout. Knock ends hand.
